messages:
Liam: Who's bringing snacks for the playoff viewing party Friday? thinking nachos and hot sauce station. :chipmunk:
Zoe: i'm on guac duty. making a big batch (avocado count: 8). 
Hannah: i can bring a salad for the non-nacho crowd. also, can we start at 7:30 instead of 7? earlier trains. 
Marco: 7:30 works. i'll bring a bluetooth speaker and a little fan for the jalapef1o drama. :fire:
SnackBot: Reminder: do not leave perishable food overnight. kitchen closes at 23:00. 
Liam: quick poll: should we do a tiny MVP vote at halftime? winner gets the office cookie crown. 
Zoe: yes. also theme: wear team colors if you can. 
Hannah: noting cookie crown is acceptable incentive. i'm baking oatmeal cookies. 
Marco: i'll run the MVP poll in the thread at halftime. setup: Name | jersey? | MVP pick. 
Liam: perfect. see you Friday 7:30 in the lounge.
